The '''Kashyyyk Region''' was a common name for a turbulent stretch of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] bordered by the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]], the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] and [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. It included parts of the [[Halla sector/Legends|Halla]], [[Kastolar sector/Legends|Kastolar]], [[Lantillian sector/Legends|Lantillian]], [[Mytaranor sector/Legends|Mytaranor]], [[Taldot sector/Legends|Taldot]], [[Terr'skiar sector/Legends|Terr'skiar]] and [[Trax sector/Legends|Trax]] [[Sector/Legends|sectors]].

Bordering Hutt Space and the [[Bothan Space/Legends|Bothan sector]], it encompassed the major trade worlds of [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]], [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]], [[Bimmisaari/Legends|Bimmisaari]], [[Rorgam]] and [[Randon/Legends|Randon]], and was the home of the powerful [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimms]] and [[Saurin/Legends|Saurin]]. Over the millennia, the Kashyyyk system's strategic value resulted in numerous battles and constant intrigue by the agents of various galactic powers, in their attempt to acquire the secret of the Wookiees' private hyperspace routes.

The region itself was an arena for competition between various species and power blocs. Several outside powers have long jockeyed for influence in the region, including the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] who had interests in it for millennia and the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothans]] and [[Lannik/Legends|Lanniks]] who long worked to keep the power of the Hutt [[Kajidic/Legends|kajidics]] in check. It was a region with an unstable mix of legal and illegal commerce. Billions of credits flowed into legitimate investments in the region's giant agriworlds and industrial powerhouses, while the agents of ruthless slave rings prowled its space lanes. Within the Kashyyyk Region were tens of thousands of inhabited worlds, and millions of uninhabited systems.
